patch.value: preflight: fail-fast Beads-JSONL schema gate before import

Register a preflight override that runs the existing structural validator (validateBeadsText) against the import input file BEFORE the importer touches the pm store. On any structural error the import aborts immediately with a clear, line-naming message and a non-zero exit, so no partial/garbage items are created. Valid files pass silently. Scoped strictly to the import path (pm beads import + pm beads-import alias); export and validate are never blocked. Adds preflight to manifest capabilities.

value.author: codex
value.text: DECISION: abort via process.exit(), not throw. The SDK's runPreflightOverride (dist/core/extensions/extension-hook-runtime.js ~L225) wraps the override in try/catch and DOWNGRADES any thrown error to a non-fatal 'extension_preflight_override_failed' warning — it does NOT propagate. A thrown CommandError would be swallowed and import would proceed, defeating the gate. So the preflight prints the actionable error and calls process.exit(exitCode) to guarantee a true fail-fast abort before any pm-store write. CommandError is still constructed to derive the canonical message + exit code, preserving the package error contract. Filed-worthy SDK note: the documented 'THROW to fail-fast' preflight contract does not actually abort in this SDK build.

value.author: codex
value.text: DECISION: scope via normalized ctx.command. Empirically discovered (temp debug preflight installed into a scratch workspace): 'pm beads import' -> command='beads import'; legacy alias 'pm beads-import' -> command='beads-import'; 'pm beads export' -> command='beads export'. Gate fires only for the set {'beads import','beads-import'}. Input file resolved as first non-flag arg (resolveImportInputFile), matching the import handler's ctx.args[0]. Reused validateBeadsText + readWorkspaceBeadIds so cross-workspace deps remain warnings (resolve at import), identical to beads validate.

value.author: codex
value.text: FUNCTIONAL TEST (real pm CLI, scratch workspace, extension installed --project): (A) MALFORMED malformed.jsonl [line2 invalid JSON, line3 missing title] -> 'Beads JSONL preflight failed ... 2 structural error(s); nothing was imported' naming line 2 [invalid_json] + line 3 [missing_title], EXIT=1, and pm list-all count:0 (NO items created). (B) VALID valid2.jsonl (3 records, deps + created_at/updated_at) -> 'Imported 3, ... linked 1 dependency edge(s), timestamped 1', EXIT=0, count:3; round-trip via pm beads export re-emits bead ids bd-10/11/12, blocked_by edge, and preserved 2026-01-02/03 timestamps. (C) pm beads export EXIT=0 not blocked. (D) pm beads-validate valid -> valid:true EXIT=0; malformed -> validate's OWN error EXIT=1 (no preflight text) = not gated. (E) legacy pm beads-import on malformed -> gated EXIT=1. (F) malformed + --dry-run (flag after path) -> still aborts EXIT=1.

patch.value: Added a registerPreflight override scoped to the import path that runs validateBeadsText on the input file before any pm-store write; aborts via process.exit on structural errors (SDK swallows thrown preflight errors), silent pass-through on valid. Added 'preflight' to manifest capabilities; existing caps audited as truthful. README + header docs updated.

Malformed JSONL aborts import immediately with a clear line-naming error + non-zero exit and zero items created; valid JSONL imports normally with deps/timestamps round-tripping; export and validate not blocked.

Exactly as expected: malformed -> exit 1, 'nothing was imported', list-all count 0; valid -> 3 imported, 1 dep linked, 1 timestamp preserved, exit 0; export exit 0; beads-validate works + not gated; legacy beads-import alias and --dry-run both gated.
Preflight Beads-JSONL schema gate implemented, built, unit-tested (29/29), and functionally proven end-to-end with real data on the pm CLI.
